JYM-GIT-BISECT(1)               Git Manual               JYM-GIT-BISECT(1)

NAME
       jym-git-bisect - Use binary search to find the commit that
       introduced a bug

SYNOPSIS
       jym-git bisect <subcommand> <options>

DESCRIPTION
       The command takes various subcommands, and different options
       depending on the subcommand.

COMMANDS
       start
           Start a bisect session.

       bad
           Mark the current or given revision as bad.

       good
           Mark the current or given revisions as good.

       skip
           Choose a nearby commit to test instead.

       reset
           Finish a bisection session and return to the original branch.

       visualize
           See the currently remaining suspects in a visual tool.

       replay
           Replay a bisection log.

       log
           Show the bisection log.

       run
           Use a script or shell command to automate bisection.

SEE ALSO
       jym-git-checkout(1)
